purpose: Article-specific selection and context for the shared organization catalogs; these are research references, not recipient enrollment or dispatch records.

workflow.complaints: File independently with competent agencies; keep actual receipt privately and record redacted dispatch only after it occurs.
workflow.coalition: Invite organizations through their designated intake to nominate willing, conflict-screened representatives. Do not equate receipt or silence with agreement.
workflow.legislative: Use constituent representatives and relevant committee offices for requests for oversight; consult official directories for the current term.

safety_and_process: Emergency or immediate risk: call 911. For current dependent-adult risk in Fresno call APS; ask for written communication accommodation.
Separate firsthand facts, allegations, records and requests for investigation. Do not presume guilt or infer public danger from affiliation alone.
File through authorized intake; do not copy every office, publish private evidence, or contact judges about a pending or prospective case. Courts adjudicate filings through proper procedures.
Committee or executive correspondence is for oversight and referral and does not toll legal deadlines. A formal agency complaint is independent of legislative outreach.
No communications sent; no status.md change. Personal authorization/consent, contact details and evidentiary materials must be submitted by the complainant through private channels.

Officeholder names are dated as shown; recheck after election transitions. Coverage of additional CDPH district offices, municipal law enforcement and exact Stanford affiliate locations remains incomplete.

medical_board.scope: Review of the user's allegation of deficient Medical Board investigation and executive and legislative oversight; not a determination of misconduct or individual responsibility.
review_questions: Obtain original case reference, date of submission, closure and disposition; determine whether closure occurred at CCU, CIO, HQIU, Board or HQE.
Determine what witness testimony and clinical evidence were requested, considered, omitted or unavailable; verify whether appropriate medical specialty expertise was used.
Ask whether conflicts were screened, the complaint was assessed against applicable contemporaneous standards and any subsequent evidence changes the disposition.

Ask for review under Business and Professions Code section 2024.5(a)(5), and determine applicability of section 2220.1 including section 2230.5 limitations. Request written determination and accessible communication.
Ask DCA Correspondence Unit to review service handling and refer evidence of state improper activity independently to State Auditor where applicable.

Ask legislators to review implementation and outcomes of enforcement monitor recommendations and SB 815, including documented interview and closure-review processes, without seeking predetermined case results.
Preserve records privately and request lawful disclosure; no confidential medical or investigative material in public comments or Git.

formal_review_routes.note: Request investigation from the competent independent agency and ask institutional offices to nominate an appropriate conflict-screened clinical reviewer. Do not broadcast individualized allegations to unrelated clinicians, community organizations or patient groups.

initial_research_state.note: All prior per-record research states were uncontacted defaults. Actual dispatch history belongs to status.md; actual replies to in/. Defaults do not imply selection or enrollment.
